#3dprinting #3dprintingtips #bambulab #prusa #gija3d

scenes.title: First layer won't stick?
scenes.say: First layer won't stick? Change these three settings today.

scenes.title: Z offset
scenes.say: One. Lower your Z offset in five hundredths of a millimeter steps until the lines squish together.

scenes.title: Slow start
scenes.say: Two. Print the first layer slow, around twenty millimeters per second.

scenes.title: Clean bed
scenes.say: Three. Wipe the bed with isopropyl alcohol. Finger oil is the number one enemy of adhesion.

scenes.title: Save this
scenes.say: Save this so you don't forget, and follow for more tips.
